<!-- ░░░ ABOUT ME ░░░ -->
## 🚀 About Me

🎓 **B.Tech ECE Student** · 2nd Year · 4th Semester · Vemu Institute of Technology, Chittoor AP — **CGPA: 9.8 🔥**

💡 I build real-world solutions at the intersection of **hardware intelligence and software power** — from sensors that think to AI that prevents road accidents.

🔬 Currently mastering **VLSI Design** — learning HDL, Verilog, CMOS circuits, and digital logic synthesis from scratch.

🤖 Selected for **e-Yantra Robotics (IIT Bombay)** — programming autonomous robots in Python + CoppeliaSim.

🏆 **Hackathon Winner 2026** — beat multiple teams at Chadalawada Ramanamma Engineering College.

🎯 Dream: Contribute to **ISRO / DRDO** in space & defence, or ship AI products at **Google / Amazon**.

⚡ I also anchor college events — because great engineers communicate as well as they code. 🎤

## 🚀 Featured Projects

### 💡 Smart Street Lighting System
> **Arduino · IR/Ultrasonic Sensors · Embedded C**
> Auto-dims street lights based on real-time vehicle detection — ~40% energy saved. Built for smart city infrastructure.

### 🚨 AI Road Accident Prevention System
> **Python · OpenCV · Machine Learning · Sensors**
> Real-time drowsiness and obstacle detection with **< 1 second** alert response. Standalone vehicle safety module.

### 🏟️ SmartStadium AI *(Live Project)*
> **Python · Groq AI · Streamlit**
> GenAI-powered assistant for FIFA World Cup 2026 stadium operations — fans, staff, organizers. **Deployed & Live!**

### 🌱 Smart Irrigation System
> **IoT · Soil Moisture Sensors · Microcontroller**
> Automated crop watering with real-time soil monitoring and IoT remote control.

### 🤖 e-Yantra Robot Navigation
> **Python · CoppeliaSim · Embedded Systems**
> Autonomous robot square-path navigation — IIT Bombay National Robotics Program 2025-26.
